info.name: AI Learning Platform — AI API
info.description:
All requests go through the **API gateway** (default `http://localhost:4000`). Paths use `/api/ai/...`; the gateway strips that prefix and forwards to the ai-service.

---

## Collection variables
| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:4000` | Gateway URL — use this for all requests |
| `aiServiceUrl` | `http://localhost:5002` | Direct ai-service URL — bypass gateway (debug only) |
| `accessToken` | _(empty)_ | Paste your JWT here after sign-in via the Auth collection |
| `sessionId` | _(empty)_ | Auto-set by the test script on Create Session |

---

## Streaming
The assistant's reply is **not** returned by `POST /chat/sessions/:id/messages` — that call
only persists and returns the user's message (`202 Accepted`). Tokens stream over Socket.io:
connect to the websocket service (default `http://localhost:4001`) with `{ auth: { token } }`,
emit `join_session` with `{ sessionId }`, and listen for `chat_event` (`token` / `done` / `error`).
See `npm run ws-test -- <JWT>` at the repo root for a working example.

---

## Auth
Every endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. The gateway validates the JWT
and also enforces the free-tier daily chat limit (`FREE_TIER_DAILY_LIMIT`) on
`POST /chat/sessions/:id/messages`. Get a token from the Auth API collection (Sign in or Sign up).
